name: sds-reviews
description: Review supplier safety data sheets (SDS) for missing or contradictory information under US OSHA HazCom. Check one SDS section by section, match a chemical inventory to its SDS library, and compare old and new SDS revisions. Works from pasted SDS text and exports; returns passage-linked findings and supplier questions.

interface.shortDescription: Review safety data sheets for OSHA HazCom gaps
interface.longDescription: Review supplier safety data sheets (SDS) for missing or contradictory information under US OSHA HazCom. Check one SDS section by section, match a chemical inventory to its SDS library, and compare old and new SDS revisions. Works from pasted SDS text and exports; returns passage-linked findings and supplier questions.
defaultPrompt: Check this supplier SDS for missing or contradictory sections.
Match our chemical inventory list to these SDS revision dates.
Compare the old and new SDS for this product and tell me what changed.
